question: 2025年极光键盘标准版的销售额是多少
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND p.name = '极光键盘-标准版' AND o.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: 2025年第一季度各地区的销售额

question: 2025年1月到3月每月销售额趋势
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.created_at)::date AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND o.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < DATE '2025-04-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 2025年第二季度销售额同比怎么样
gold_sql: WITH current_period AS (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND o.created_at < DATE '2025-07-01' AND o.status = 'PAID'), previous_period AS (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE '2024-04-01' AND o.created_at < DATE '2024-07-01' AND o.status = 'PAID') SELECT c.value, p.value, ROUND(((c.value - p.value) / NULLIF(p.value, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM current_period c CROSS JOIN previous_period p

question: 2025年支付宝一共支付了多少次

question: 华东实验学校2025年购买商品的销量前五名
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND c.name = '华东实验学校' AND o.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY sold_quantity DESC, p.name LIMIT 5
